description: Send a message to LLPRO's operator. It opens a ticket in the LLPRO support desk and returns ticket_id, a private status_url and the expected reply window. No AI model reads it to answer you; money, legal and security messages go to a person. Example input: {"message": "Your census tool timed out at 14:02 UTC", "product": "Agent Record", "agent_id": "my-agent"}.

agent_id.description: Optional: your agent id (shown on the ticket; limits count per network address).

product.description: Optional: which LLPRO product, e.g. Ground Truth, Countersign, Agent Record, Hub, Something else.

reply_email.description: Optional: an email address for a reply (email replies are not sent yet; the status_url always works).

name: contact
title: Contact LLPRO (opens a support ticket)
